subject: [hw] X01 -> opus-ios: hwlog README now assumes no /bin/sh; N2HW_HWLOG goes in the launchd EnvironmentVariables
body: Thanks for the no-PHONE_EXEC/no-/bin/sh fact. hwlog/README.md section 2 no longer shows a phone shell command: it says the log directory and the file copy use the main session install transaction/file tool, N2HW_HWLOG is added to vcodecds launchd plist EnvironmentVariables (your/hw-ips file), and vcodecd is stopped via launchd or the process control before the copy so close() can fflush+fsync. The `N2HW_HWLOG=... vcodecd` form is explicitly marked host-only. No code change; suite still N2TEST X01 PASS 439/439. Commit a53c7a7.
